speech.heard: USA invests 3.4% in research, Iraq has 0.04%, 85 times the investment. The USA invests to drive new discovery and technology. Iraq spends a tiny fraction of its total economy. This counts capital and current spending in business, government and higher education sectors. Side by side, USA at 3.4% and Iraq at 0.04%. Half of all countries invest 0.6% or less. Israel is the world's highest at 6.3%. South Korea has 4.9%. Sweden has 3.6%. What kind of research should your nation prioritize?
